title: Le vol — au plus près du leurre

input.prompt:
Photoreal cinematic footage, dawn on a misty alpine lake, cold blue light, a pale amber band low on the horizon, a long bank of low fog lying on the water, filmic contrast, fine natural grain, real time, no slow motion, 24 fps look.

Continuous low chase over the water: the camera closes alongside a small two-section jointed swimbait (olive-yellow back, soft pink flank band, pearl-white belly, translucent forked tail, two exposed metal pin joints, two dark treble hooks) as it flies through drifting mist, ending in close-up on the lure in mid-air, treble hooks hanging, the taut line running back to the right of frame, pale sunrise glow on the left, mirror-calm water below, the lure just beginning to drop, no cut.

Avoid entirely: text, captions, watermark, logo, brand name, extra fish, extra boats, birds, morphing lure, changing lure colour, extra hooks, duplicated lure, readable human face, cartoon look, HDR oversaturation.
